design_description: A dark burgundy and black jersey with a refined, aggressive visual language. The body uses deep wine-red as the core colour, fading into black shoulders and sleeves, with subtle tonal graphics adding depth without lifting the overall darkness of the kit. The main pattern consists of sharp, symmetrical sweeping lines rising from the lower torso, creating an abstract horn and flame effect that reinforces the bull identity without simply repeating the crest. Because the pattern is worked tone-on-tone, it reads as texture from distance and only resolves into the horn shapes up close. Thin metallic-gold vertical lines frame the central chest area, with matching gold detailing on the collar and cuffs, giving the dark base a clean structural frame. The back continues the same dark tonal pattern and burgundy-to-black treatment, finished with a large gold name and number that stand out cleanly against the deep base. Overall it feels premium, dark and powerful, with the restrained gold accents giving the kit a more elevated finish than a purely black-and-red design would achieve.
